scripts.dev: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @orbit/api" "npm run dev -w @orbit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && npm run build -w @orbit/api && npm run build -w @orbit/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orbit/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
